Collecting marvels is thus a method of induction from the boundary cases of Heaven-Human response.","logic_chain":"1) Ordinary life hides causal structure; anomalies make causes visible. 2) If anomaly is carefully attested, it functions as empirical residue of 感应 (resonance). 3) Resonance implies moral, ritual, or destiny variables acting as causes. 4) Therefore editorial selection of marvels is argument by extreme cases. 5) Conclusion: narrative wonder is a logic of proof for hidden order, not entertainment.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi reading, treat rare chart patterns as high-signal anomalies that reveal base rules more clearly than common charts. 2) When life events contradict surface strength/weakness, seek the hidden 感应 variable (year pillar clash, hidden stem, luck cycle timing). 3) Keep a case library of unusual outcomes to refine judgment rules. 4) Use stories as training in causal discrimination: separate coincidence from patterned response. 5) Cultivate by watching ‘edge cases’ of emotion and circumstance as mirrors of chart imbalances.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure fiction anthologies, 虞初新志 presents marvels as curated testimony with Qing literati editorial judgment. It differs from 夷坚志-style Buddhist retribution corpora by mixing moral proof with aesthetic and social critique, so its logic is less karmic ledger and more resonance-as-evidence."},{"name_han":"淞滨琐话","logic_thesis":"Late-Qing coastal modernity does not abolish the occult logic of destiny and spirit; it relocates it into new social spaces. The text proves that cosmological reasoning remains valid when traditional institutions fray, because human desire and fate still produce patterned ‘strange’ outcomes.","logic_chain":"1) Social transition multiplies ambiguous events. 2) Ambiguity invites both scientific and metaphysical interpretation. 3) If narrative repeatedly maps desire, betrayal, and fortune onto spirit causality, a continuity claim is advanced. 4) Continuity of causal patterning across eras implies fate-logic is not period-bound. 5) Conclusion: modernity tests, rather than falsifies, traditional causal grammar.","logic_practice":"1) Read modern BaZi clients’ urban careers as new vessels of old 财官印食 dynamics. 2) Translate ‘spirit encounter’ motifs into psychological timing: when luck pillars open 比劫/伤官, obsessive or uncanny experiences rise. 3) Do not discard traditional omens; re-specify their social carriers (media, finance, migration). 4) Practice cultivation as maintaining 神不外驰 amid modern sensory flood. 5) Use coastal/mercantile symbolism (travel, foreign goods) as 财星 mobility diagnostics.","logic_compare":"Compared with earlier 志怪, 淞滨琐话 is more hybrid: romance, news, and ghost-lore share one causal frame. It differs from 虞初新志 by being less classical-anthology and more newspaper-age local knowledge, so its proof strategy is contemporaneity rather than antique authority."},{"name_han":"湖海新闻夷坚续志","logic_thesis":"News-like transmission of marvels is itself an epistemic method: the text proves that retributive and resonant causality can be socially verified through circulating reports. ‘News’ is not journalism in the modern sense but a claim that Heaven’s responses leave public traces.","logic_chain":"1) Private sin and virtue would be unverifiable without public aftermath. 2) Circulated marvels convert private moral states into shared evidence. 3) Continuity with 夷坚志 implies a standing research program into 报应. 4) If many independent locales report similar causal shapes, pattern reliability rises. 5) Conclusion: collective anecdote aggregation is a proto-statistical proof of moral cosmology.","logic_practice":"1) Treat client ‘coincidence chains’ as multi-source confirmation, not single anecdote. 2) In BaZi, weight outcomes that repeat across luck cycles higher than one-off events. 3) When reading 官杀 for legal/ethical risk, look for public manifestation timing. 4) Cultivate by auditing speech and intention as if they will leave ‘news-like’ traces. 5) Build pattern tables: chart feature → event type → delay length.","logic_compare":"It inherits 夷坚志’s retribution engine but frames itself as 新闻, stressing recency and breadth. Unlike purely Buddhist 冥报 collections, it is broader Song popular cosmology—Daoist, Buddhist, and folk—so its logic is encyclopedic pattern-hunting rather than sectarian preaching."},{"name_han":"高坡异纂","logic_thesis":"Ming literati marvel-collection proves that elite culture still requires a theater of the uncanny to police desire, status, and cosmic hierarchy. The argument is that ‘strange’ events function as a moral-cosmological corrective when Confucian surface order is insufficient.","logic_chain":"1) Official order regulates visible conduct only. 2) Hidden desire and ghostly debt operate beneath office and rank. 3) Recording anomalies reintroduces hidden variables into elite self-understanding. 4) Therefore 异纂 is a supplement to ritual and law. 5) Conclusion: the strange is a necessary epistemic layer for complete social cosmology.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi, when 官杀 appear strong but ethics fail, inspect 食伤 and 印 for hidden leakage. 2) Use ‘elite anomaly’ cases as models for high-status clients whose public image masks chart instability. 3) Practice night self-examination as 高坡-style private audit. 4) Read dreams/omens as data on unregulated 七杀 or 伤官. 5) In cultivation, treat status pride as a primary interference with 神.","logic_compare":"Narrower and more Ming-scholarly than Song 夷坚 corpora, less encyclopedic and more literati-salon in tone. Compared with 庚巳编, it is more marvel-centered and less personal memoir; its logic is corrective spectacle rather than daily observation."},{"name_han":"庚巳编","logic_thesis":"Personal, dated observation of anomalies proves that cosmic irregularity is continuous with ordinary bureaucratic and familial life. The text’s argument is empirical intimacy: if a scholar’s lived calendar can host the strange, then cosmology is not remote metaphysics but near-field causality.","logic_chain":"1) First-person dating anchors events in real time. 2) Anchored anomalies resist pure allegory. 3) Continuity between office, illness, omen, and dream implies one causal field. 4) Therefore the scholar’s notebook is a field log of 天人. 5) Conclusion: credible cosmology is built from proximate, time-stamped cases.","logic_practice":"1) Keep BaZi case notes with exact dates (onset, peak, resolution) against luck pillars. 2) Prefer proximate evidence (client’s lived timeline) over generic textbook images. 3) Map illness, career, and dreams on one chart timeline to test single-field causality. 4) Cultivate daily journaling as 感应 instrumentation. 5) When chart prediction fails, revise premises from dated counterexamples.","logic_compare":"More memoir-like and less anthology-spectacle than 高坡异纂 or 夷坚续志. Its proof differs by authorial nearness: not ‘what people say happened’ but ‘what I observed in my years,’ so epistemic weight comes from temporal precision."},{"name_han":"管子校正","logic_thesis":"Textual criticism of 管子 proves that political-cosmic doctrine is only as strong as the integrity of its wording: governance theory (including 气, 时, 法) cannot be practiced from corrupt transmission. The argument is that correct policy and correct cosmology both require a cleaned textual base.","logic_chain":"1) 管子 claims state order mirrors natural regularities. 2) If the text is corrupt, the mirror is warped. 3) Philological correction restores operable premises. 4) Operable premises allow consistent inference from seasons, measures, and human nature to law. 5) Conclusion: editorial rigor is a precondition of applied Dao-legal statecraft.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi study, refuse to apply verses or formulas without source vetting (which lineage, which edition). 2) Build a ‘corrected core’ of Five-Phase and timing rules before advanced techniques. 3) Treat contradictory classics as transmission problems first, metaphysics second. 4) Cultivate 正名: precise naming of chart factors prevents policy-like misrule of self. 5) Use Guanzi’s seasonal administration as model for luck-cycle pacing (do right action in right time).","logic_compare":"Unlike philosophical commentary alone, 校正 prioritizes textual hygiene over doctrinal flourish. It differs from 管子义证 by focusing on establishing the correct wording/base text rather than amassing semantic proofs; without it, later 义证 would argue over noise."},{"name_han":"管子义证","logic_thesis":"义证 proves meaning by cumulative external and internal evidence: the text’s logic is that Guanzi’s political cosmology is defensible only when each claim is tethered to parallel passages, institutions, and word usage. Understanding is a courtroom of citations, not intuition.","logic_chain":"1) Isolated maxims are ambiguous. 2) Ambiguity is reduced by collating parallels and usages. 3) Collation yields constrained semantic ranges. 4) Constrained meaning yields constrained political-cosmological application. 5) Conclusion: legitimacy of practice depends on evidential semantics.","logic_practice":"1) For any BaZi rule, demand 义证: classic locus + historical cases + internal consistency. 2) When teachers conflict, build a proof table rather than pick by charisma. 3) Apply Guanzi’s 轻重/timing economics to 财星 strategy: scarcity, timing, circulation. 4) Cultivate by testing each insight against body-breath-season feedback. 5) Write short ‘义证 notes’ for chart conclusions to prevent storytelling drift.","logic_compare":"Complementary to 管子校正: 义证 argues sense, 校正 argues text. Compared with 韩非子集解-style legalist commentary, it is more reconstructive of a composite political corpus than of a single sharp authorial system."},{"name_han":"吕氏春秋集释","logic_thesis":"Collected exegesis of 吕氏春秋 proves that eclectic synthesis (Dao, Confucian, Yin-Yang, agricultural timing) is a deliberate logic of completeness: rule and self-rule require integrating seasonal cosmology with ethics and technique. The argument is systematic eclecticism as rational state-and-life design.","logic_chain":"1) Single-school premises leave practical gaps. 2) Seasonal, moral, and technical domains interact. 3) Integration under ‘act according to time’ yields a unified decision theory. 4) Commentary multiplies readings but aims at operable unity. 5) Conclusion: true order is timed coordination of many causal layers.","logic_practice":"1) Structure BaZi counsel like 十二纪: month/season first, then ethics, then tactics. 2) When chart shows strong 木/春 imagery, prioritize growth actions; 金/秋, pruning and completion. 3) Use multi-factor synthesis without random stacking: each factor must have a timing role. 4) Cultivate with monthly micro-vows matching 月令. 5) Resolve client conflicts by asking which ‘season of life’ the luck cycle is.","logic_compare":"More encyclopedic and calendar-driven than 韩非子之 pure institutional logic, less purely Daoist-mystical than 淮南. 集释 differs from bare 吕氏春秋 by making the tradition’s polyphony explicit and adjudicated through layered commentary."},{"name_han":"淮南鸿烈解","logic_thesis":"Exegesis of 淮南子 (鸿烈) proves that cosmic pattern (道-气-阴阳-五行) is the deep grammar of politics, body, and knowledge. The argument is correspondence: micro-actions succeed only when aligned with macro-structure; misalignment is not mere error but cosmic friction.","logic_chain":"1) Dao differentiates into qi, yin-yang, five phases. 2) Human affairs are localized expressions of that differentiation. 3) Therefore diagnosis of person/state is diagnosis of phase imbalance. 4) Commentary stabilizes how correspondences map to practice. 5) Conclusion: wisdom is skilled isomorphism between chart-of-world and chart-of-self.","logic_practice":"1) Read BaZi as a 淮南-style correspondence engine: stems/branches as local cosmology. 2) Prefer root-cause phase repair (印 for overactive 食伤, etc.) over symptom chasing. 3) Use imagery of 天人 in counseling language to restore client’s sense of scale. 4) Cultivate 虚静 to sense qi shifts before events crystallize. 5) Time interventions to 生气/死气 logic within luck cycles.","logic_compare":"Broader and more cosmological than 韩非子; more Han imperial synthesis than 管子’s statecraft core. 解 literature differs from bare 淮南子 by turning mythic cosmology into teachable mappings—closer to applied correlative science than to free philosophical essay."},{"name_han":"韩非子集解","logic_thesis":"集解 proves that order arises from clear standards, incentives, and information control—not from charismatic virtue alone. Applied to destiny thinking, it argues that patterns (法) must be impersonal: if causes are regular, judgments should be rule-bound, not flattering.","logic_chain":"1) Human self-interest is predictable. 2) Predictable motives make institutional design possible. 3) Transparent standards outperform ad hoc moralizing. 4) Commentary gathers schools of reading into a usable legalist toolkit. 5) Conclusion: reliable governance—and reliable forecast—requires non-negotiable rules plus situational 势.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi, state rules before exceptions; do not rewrite 十神 logic for status clients. 2) Assess 官杀 as ‘standards and enforcement,’ 财 as resources, 印 as cover/authorization. 3) Use 势: luck cycle as temporary power gradient that enables or disables chart potentials. 4) Cultivate by installing personal 法: fixed sleep, speech, and vow rules. 5) Audit self-deception as Han Fei’s ‘blocked information channels’ inside the mind.","logic_compare":"Sharper and more anti-charisma than 吕氏/淮南 synthesis texts. Unlike 管子, which still integrates seasonal cosmology and economy, 韩非子 centers institutional mechanism; 集解’s logic is forensic and administrative rather than correlative-mystical."},{"name_han":"鹖冠子解","logic_thesis":"Exegesis of 鹖冠子 proves a military-political Dao: success depends on reading forms (形), names, and cosmic timing together. The argument is that strategy is applied metaphysics—knowing how invisible propensity becomes visible configuration.","logic_chain":"1) Dao is not empty abstraction; it issues measurable 形 and 名. 2) Political-military failure is misreading of form and timing. 3) Correct 解 restores the text’s operational vocabulary. 4) Operational vocabulary links Heaven’s patterns to human decision. 5) Conclusion: wisdom is preemptive alignment with emerging form, not late force.","logic_practice":"1) Treat BaZi as strategic 形名: chart structure is form; luck cycle is emerging propensity. 2) Act early in 长生/冠带 phases; conserve in 死/墓. 3) Name chart conflicts precisely (who clashes whom) before prescribing remedies. 4) Cultivate 观变: daily observation of small form-shifts in mood and circumstance. 5) Prefer positional advantage (environment, role, network) over brute effort when 势 is weak.","logic_compare":"More strategic and Huang-Lao than pure Confucian ethics, less legalist-hard than 韩非子. Compared with 淮南’s broad cosmology, 鹖冠子 is tighter on state-war decision loops; 解 makes that operational lexicon legible."},{"name_han":"冥报记","logic_thesis":"Tang 冥报 narratives prove that moral causation is temporally extended beyond death and social visibility: unseen tribunals complete the ledger of deeds. The argument is eschatological accountability as the guarantor of ethical rationality.","logic_chain":"1) If wrongdoing often prospers in life, ethics need a completion mechanism. 2) Hell-report stories supply that mechanism with narrative evidence. 3) Fear and hope become cognitive tools for behavioral reform. 4) Therefore retribution tales are moral technology, not mere scare folklore. 5) Conclusion: cosmic justice is claimed as structured, timed, and witnessable through signs.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi, read sudden collapses after ethical breaches as 官杀/劫财 enforcement timing, not random bad luck. 2) Use delayed retribution logic to explain multi-cycle payoffs. 3) For cultivation, install confession and repair practices before ‘court’ timing matures. 4) Treat nightmares and omens as early notices in a 冥报 system. 5) Counsel clients on 积德 as actual risk management in chart terms.","logic_compare":"More systematically Buddhist-retributive than general 志怪. Unlike 夷坚-style mixed marvels, 冥报记 has a prosecutorial structure (deed → underworld process → report), so its logic is judicial rather than purely wondrous."},{"name_han":"续玄怪录","logic_thesis":"Continuation of 玄怪 proves that the boundary between human time and otherworld time is porous, and that destiny appointments (marriage, office, death) are often pre-scripted yet interactively revealed. The argument is that narrative strangeness discloses a bookkeeping of fate behind ordinary careers.","logic_chain":"1) Ordinary biography seems contingent. 2) Otherworld encounters reveal prewritten registers. 3) If registers can be glimpsed or bargained with, fate is structured but not always opaque. 4) Continuation of the genre multiplies test cases of that structure. 5) Conclusion: life planning should include the logic of predestination-with-interfaces.","logic_practice":"1) Treat BaZi as the ‘register’ layer; luck cycles as moments when register becomes readable through events. 2) For marriage/office pillars, expect meeting-point events that feel ‘arranged.’ 3) Practice dream and omen literacy as interface skills, not superstition. 4) Cultivate acceptance plus skilled response: change what 用神 allows, release what 忌神 locks. 5) When clients report uncanny timing, map it precisely to pillar activations.","logic_compare":"More literarily polished and fate-bureaucratic than early bare 齐谐 marvels. Compared with 冥报记, it is less hell-court moralism and more destiny-administration aesthetics—fate as office system rather than pure karmic prison."},{"name_han":"续齐谐记","logic_thesis":"As a sequel in the 齐谐 lineage, it proves that categorizing the strange preserves a cognitive method: anomaly types (dream, object spirit, seasonal portent) train pattern recognition of non-ordinary causality. The argument is taxonomized wonder as knowledge.","logic_chain":"1) Unsorted marvels overwhelm judgment. 2) Genre continuation implies a stable typology. 3) Typology enables comparison and inference across cases. 4) Inference yields rules of encounter and taboo. 5) Conclusion: the strange becomes teachable through classification.","logic_practice":"1) Build a BaZi anomaly taxonomy: timing glitches, repeated number motifs, relationship echoes. 2) Match omen type to chart layer (daymaster mood vs year-pillar social field). 3) Teach clients simple taboo calendars tied to their 忌神 days. 4) Cultivate by classifying inner states as carefully as outer marvels. 5) Use short case cards rather than long lore for decision speed.","logic_compare":"Later and often more refined than 齐谐记 proper; less grand-geographical than 十洲记. Its difference from 续玄怪录 is scale and tone: more brief marvel entries and less elaborate fate-romance architecture."},{"name_han":"仙传拾遗","logic_thesis":"Du Guangting’s immortal hagiography proves that transcendence is a path with techniques, virtues, and historical witnesses—not a vague metaphor. The argument is that immortality narratives encode a curriculum: discipline, timing, place, and teacher transmission.","logic_chain":"1) If many biographies share stages (trial, formula, ascent), a method is implied. 2) Shared method implies learnable structure. 3) Hagiography thus functions as case law of cultivation success. 4) Daoist editorial selection emphasizes orthodox transmission. 5) Conclusion: spiritual attainment is argued by patterned life-evidence across persons.","logic_practice":"1) Map immortal career stages onto BaZi luck cycles: training in weak resource years, breakthrough in supportive 印/食 cycles. 2) Extract concrete disciplines (fasting patterns, ethics, mountain retreat) as 用神 lifestyle. 3) Treat ‘teacher appearance’ motifs as 印星 activation timing. 4) Cultivate with biography-based milestones rather than vague aspiration. 5) Use failure stories in the corpus as risk models for 伤官见官-type spiritual arrogance.","logic_compare":"More systematically Daoist and soteriological than secular 志怪. Differs from 冥报记 by aiming at transcendence rather than underworld deterrence; differs from 十洲记 by focusing on persons and methods rather than sacred geography alone."},{"name_han":"五行大义","logic_thesis":"Xiao Ji’s treatise proves that Five-Phase theory is a complete inferential system: numbers, stems, branches, tones, organs, and politics can be deduced from phase relations if definitions and generative/control orders are held consistent. The argument is systematic correlative rationality.","logic_chain":"1) Phases are defined by functional relations (生克). 2) Domains (time, body, ethics, state) are mapped onto those relations. 3) Mapping allows transfer of inference across domains. 4) Consistency checks prevent arbitrary symbolism. 5) Conclusion: Five-Phase is a logic engine for diagnosis and timing, not a pile of images.","logic_practice":"1) Ground every BaZi judgment in explicit 生克制化 before story-telling. 2) Use classical correspondences (seasons, organs, directions) as constrained dictionaries. 3) When two techniques conflict, return to phase algebra as court of appeal. 4) Cultivate through seasonal regimen matching personal phase imbalances. 5) Drill transformation chains (e.g., 泄-耗-克) as decision trees for remedies.","logic_compare":"Unlike narrative 志怪 proofs, 五行大义 is axiomatic and encyclopedic. It differs from 淮南’s literary cosmology by being more scholastic and table-driven; it is the technical spine that later BaZi arithmetic assumes."},{"name_han":"古楼观紫云衍庆集","logic_thesis":"The Louguan temple corpus proves that sacred place, lineage memory, and imperial/religious endorsement co-produce Daoist authority. The argument is institutional: the Way is transmitted not only by texts and techniques but by a consecrated geography and commemorative record.","logic_chain":"1) Cultivation claims need social and spatial anchors. 2) Temple history and numinous signs (紫云) certify those anchors. 3) Anthologizing miracles and genealogies stabilizes orthodoxy. 4) Orthodoxy enables standardized teaching. 5) Conclusion: spiritual legitimacy is argued through place-lineage-sign triangulation.","logic_practice":"1) In practice, treat ‘place luck’ (residence, altar direction) as coequal with natal chart for cultivation. 2) Seek teacher/lineage clarity as 印; avoid floating techniques without transmission. 3) Use commemorative ritual to lock intention (誓) into time. 4) Read temple-sign stories as models for verifying 感应 in sacred space. 5) Align retreats with personal 驿马/空亡 patterns for mountain practice timing.","logic_compare":"Unlike purely textual philosophers (管子/韩非子), this is sacred institutional memory. It differs from free immortal tales by centering one holy site’s continuity; its logic is foundation-and-lineage certification rather than portable story entertainment."},{"name_han":"齐谐记","logic_thesis":"Early 齐谐-style recording proves that ‘strange’ is a legitimate object of knowledge: what exceeds common sense still obeys nameable motifs and moral-cosmic hints. The argument inaugurates anomaly as data for Heaven-Human inference.","logic_chain":"1) Common sense covers only high-frequency events. 2) Low-frequency events still occur and recur in types. 3) Recording types builds a second-order map of reality. 4) That map feeds ritual caution and interpretive skill. 5) Conclusion: ignoring the strange is an incomplete epistemology.","logic_practice":"1) Maintain a personal ‘齐谐’ log of rare chart events to expand model coverage. 2) Do not force every anomaly into textbook 十神; first describe, then classify. 3) Use early-zhiguai cautionary motifs as client risk metaphors. 4) Cultivate 戒—boundaries that protect against chaotic 感. 5) Train beginners on clear anomaly cases before subtle ones.","logic_compare":"More foundational and fragmentary than later sequels (续齐谐记) and grand Tang tales. Compared with 五行大义, it proves by narrative instance rather than by systematic phase algebra; it is the empirical folklore root of correlative fear and wonder."},{"name_han":"海内十洲记","logic_thesis":"The Ten Continents text proves that sacred geography is a cosmology in spatial form: immortality, herbs, and hierarchical isles encode graded access to Dao. The argument is that spiritual rank corresponds to locational ontology—where you can go depends on what you have become.","logic_chain":"1) Space is morally and energetically stratified. 2) Each continent/isle holds specific substances and beings. 3) Access conditions imply cultivation prerequisites. 4) Geography thus teaches a ladder of transformation. 5) Conclusion: map-reading is rank-reading in Daoist imagination.","logic_practice":"1) Translate ‘isles’ into practice zones: altar, retreat, travel, sleep—each with purity rules. 2) In BaZi, link 驿马 and resource stars to beneficial directions and moves. 3) Treat rare medicines/methods as phase-specific 用神, not universal panaceas. 4) Cultivate graded access: ethics before advanced techniques (no skip-island). 5) Use visualization of pure lands as 神 training without confusing map with tourism.","logic_compare":"More spatial-ontological than person-focused 仙传; more mythic atlas than 冥报 courtroom. Differs from 齐谐 short marvels by offering a structured otherworld cartography that functions as a curriculum of places."},{"name_han":"虬髯客传","logic_thesis":"The tale proves a political-destiny logic: true kingship and heroic talent are timed appointments under Heaven; recognizing 真命 and yielding at the right moment is supreme strategy. The argument is that force without cosmic timing fails, while insight into destiny reorders alliances and wealth.","logic_chain":"1) Chaotic times multiply contenders. 2) Signs and talent-reading reveal the true sovereign trajectory. 3) The superior hero reallocates resources once destiny is clear. 4) Withdrawal to another field (海外) converts loss into alternative sovereignty. 5) Conclusion: wisdom is accurate destiny diagnosis plus non-resentful strategic redeployment.","logic_practice":"1) In BaZi career reading, distinguish ‘can contend’ from ‘should contend’ using 帝旺 vs opposing 官杀 seasons. 2) Teach clients the 虬髯 move: when 用神 shows another’s rise, pivot domain rather than mutual destruction. 3) Read network triangulation (hero-heroine-guest) as 比劫/官/财 interaction model. 4) Cultivate 知止: stopping as advanced skill, not weakness. 5) Time major moves to luck pillars that support 迁移 and 食伤 output, not pure 七杀 brute push.","logic_compare":"Unlike pure immortal hagiography, it is chuanqi political theology in human drama. Differs from 韩非 institutional logic by centering charismatic destiny recognition; differs from 冥报 moral courts by resolving through strategic renunciation and alternate kingship rather than postmortem punishment."}]}

entries.logic_chain: 1) Official order regulates visible conduct only. 2) Hidden desire and ghostly debt operate beneath office and rank. 3) Recording anomalies reintroduces hidden variables into elite self-understanding. 4) Therefore 异纂 is a supplement to ritual and law. 5) Conclusion: the strange is a necessary epistemic layer for complete social cosmology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, when 官杀 appear strong but ethics fail, inspect 食伤 and 印 for hidden leakage. 2) Use ‘elite anomaly’ cases as models for high-status clients whose public image masks chart instability. 3) Practice night self-examination as 高坡-style private audit. 4) Read dreams/omens as data on unregulated 七杀 or 伤官. 5) In cultivation, treat status pride as a primary interference with 神.
entries.logic_compare: Narrower and more Ming-scholarly than Song 夷坚 corpora, less encyclopedic and more literati-salon in tone. Compared with 庚巳编, it is more marvel-centered and less personal memoir; its logic is corrective spectacle rather than daily observation.

entries.logic_thesis: Personal, dated observation of anomalies proves that cosmic irregularity is continuous with ordinary bureaucratic and familial life. The text’s argument is empirical intimacy: if a scholar’s lived calendar can host the strange, then cosmology is not remote metaphysics but near-field causality.
entries.logic_chain: 1) First-person dating anchors events in real time. 2) Anchored anomalies resist pure allegory. 3) Continuity between office, illness, omen, and dream implies one causal field. 4) Therefore the scholar’s notebook is a field log of 天人. 5) Conclusion: credible cosmology is built from proximate, time-stamped cases.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Keep BaZi case notes with exact dates (onset, peak, resolution) against luck pillars. 2) Prefer proximate evidence (client’s lived timeline) over generic textbook images. 3) Map illness, career, and dreams on one chart timeline to test single-field causality. 4) Cultivate daily journaling as 感应 instrumentation. 5) When chart prediction fails, revise premises from dated counterexamples.
entries.logic_compare: More memoir-like and less anthology-spectacle than 高坡异纂 or 夷坚续志. Its proof differs by authorial nearness: not ‘what people say happened’ but ‘what I observed in my years,’ so epistemic weight comes from temporal precision.

entries.logic_thesis: Textual criticism of 管子 proves that political-cosmic doctrine is only as strong as the integrity of its wording: governance theory (including 气, 时, 法) cannot be practiced from corrupt transmission. The argument is that correct policy and correct cosmology both require a cleaned textual base.
entries.logic_chain: 1) 管子 claims state order mirrors natural regularities. 2) If the text is corrupt, the mirror is warped. 3) Philological correction restores operable premises. 4) Operable premises allow consistent inference from seasons, measures, and human nature to law. 5) Conclusion: editorial rigor is a precondition of applied Dao-legal statecraft.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi study, refuse to apply verses or formulas without source vetting (which lineage, which edition). 2) Build a ‘corrected core’ of Five-Phase and timing rules before advanced techniques. 3) Treat contradictory classics as transmission problems first, metaphysics second. 4) Cultivate 正名: precise naming of chart factors prevents policy-like misrule of self. 5) Use Guanzi’s seasonal administration as model for luck-cycle pacing (do right action in right time).
entries.logic_compare: Unlike philosophical commentary alone, 校正 prioritizes textual hygiene over doctrinal flourish. It differs from 管子义证 by focusing on establishing the correct wording/base text rather than amassing semantic proofs; without it, later 义证 would argue over noise.

entries.logic_thesis: 义证 proves meaning by cumulative external and internal evidence: the text’s logic is that Guanzi’s political cosmology is defensible only when each claim is tethered to parallel passages, institutions, and word usage. Understanding is a courtroom of citations, not intuition.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Isolated maxims are ambiguous. 2) Ambiguity is reduced by collating parallels and usages. 3) Collation yields constrained semantic ranges. 4) Constrained meaning yields constrained political-cosmological application. 5) Conclusion: legitimacy of practice depends on evidential semantics.
entries.logic_practice: 1) For any BaZi rule, demand 义证: classic locus + historical cases + internal consistency. 2) When teachers conflict, build a proof table rather than pick by charisma. 3) Apply Guanzi’s 轻重/timing economics to 财星 strategy: scarcity, timing, circulation. 4) Cultivate by testing each insight against body-breath-season feedback. 5) Write short ‘义证 notes’ for chart conclusions to prevent storytelling drift.
entries.logic_compare: Complementary to 管子校正: 义证 argues sense, 校正 argues text. Compared with 韩非子集解-style legalist commentary, it is more reconstructive of a composite political corpus than of a single sharp authorial system.

entries.logic_thesis: Collected exegesis of 吕氏春秋 proves that eclectic synthesis (Dao, Confucian, Yin-Yang, agricultural timing) is a deliberate logic of completeness: rule and self-rule require integrating seasonal cosmology with ethics and technique. The argument is systematic eclecticism as rational state-and-life design.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Single-school premises leave practical gaps. 2) Seasonal, moral, and technical domains interact. 3) Integration under ‘act according to time’ yields a unified decision theory. 4) Commentary multiplies readings but aims at operable unity. 5) Conclusion: true order is timed coordination of many causal layers.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Structure BaZi counsel like 十二纪: month/season first, then ethics, then tactics. 2) When chart shows strong 木/春 imagery, prioritize growth actions; 金/秋, pruning and completion. 3) Use multi-factor synthesis without random stacking: each factor must have a timing role. 4) Cultivate with monthly micro-vows matching 月令. 5) Resolve client conflicts by asking which ‘season of life’ the luck cycle is.
entries.logic_compare: More encyclopedic and calendar-driven than 韩非子之 pure institutional logic, less purely Daoist-mystical than 淮南. 集释 differs from bare 吕氏春秋 by making the tradition’s polyphony explicit and adjudicated through layered commentary.

entries.logic_thesis: Exegesis of 淮南子 (鸿烈) proves that cosmic pattern (道-气-阴阳-五行) is the deep grammar of politics, body, and knowledge. The argument is correspondence: micro-actions succeed only when aligned with macro-structure; misalignment is not mere error but cosmic friction.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Dao differentiates into qi, yin-yang, five phases. 2) Human affairs are localized expressions of that differentiation. 3) Therefore diagnosis of person/state is diagnosis of phase imbalance. 4) Commentary stabilizes how correspondences map to practice. 5) Conclusion: wisdom is skilled isomorphism between chart-of-world and chart-of-self.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read BaZi as a 淮南-style correspondence engine: stems/branches as local cosmology. 2) Prefer root-cause phase repair (印 for overactive 食伤, etc.) over symptom chasing. 3) Use imagery of 天人 in counseling language to restore client’s sense of scale. 4) Cultivate 虚静 to sense qi shifts before events crystallize. 5) Time interventions to 生气/死气 logic within luck cycles.
entries.logic_compare: Broader and more cosmological than 韩非子; more Han imperial synthesis than 管子’s statecraft core. 解 literature differs from bare 淮南子 by turning mythic cosmology into teachable mappings—closer to applied correlative science than to free philosophical essay.

entries.logic_thesis: 集解 proves that order arises from clear standards, incentives, and information control—not from charismatic virtue alone. Applied to destiny thinking, it argues that patterns (法) must be impersonal: if causes are regular, judgments should be rule-bound, not flattering.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Human self-interest is predictable. 2) Predictable motives make institutional design possible. 3) Transparent standards outperform ad hoc moralizing. 4) Commentary gathers schools of reading into a usable legalist toolkit. 5) Conclusion: reliable governance—and reliable forecast—requires non-negotiable rules plus situational 势.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, state rules before exceptions; do not rewrite 十神 logic for status clients. 2) Assess 官杀 as ‘standards and enforcement,’ 财 as resources, 印 as cover/authorization. 3) Use 势: luck cycle as temporary power gradient that enables or disables chart potentials. 4) Cultivate by installing personal 法: fixed sleep, speech, and vow rules. 5) Audit self-deception as Han Fei’s ‘blocked information channels’ inside the mind.
entries.logic_compare: Sharper and more anti-charisma than 吕氏/淮南 synthesis texts. Unlike 管子, which still integrates seasonal cosmology and economy, 韩非子 centers institutional mechanism; 集解’s logic is forensic and administrative rather than correlative-mystical.

entries.logic_thesis: Exegesis of 鹖冠子 proves a military-political Dao: success depends on reading forms (形), names, and cosmic timing together. The argument is that strategy is applied metaphysics—knowing how invisible propensity becomes visible configuration.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Dao is not empty abstraction; it issues measurable 形 and 名. 2) Political-military failure is misreading of form and timing. 3) Correct 解 restores the text’s operational vocabulary. 4) Operational vocabulary links Heaven’s patterns to human decision. 5) Conclusion: wisdom is preemptive alignment with emerging form, not late force.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat BaZi as strategic 形名: chart structure is form; luck cycle is emerging propensity. 2) Act early in 长生/冠带 phases; conserve in 死/墓. 3) Name chart conflicts precisely (who clashes whom) before prescribing remedies. 4) Cultivate 观变: daily observation of small form-shifts in mood and circumstance. 5) Prefer positional advantage (environment, role, network) over brute effort when 势 is weak.
entries.logic_compare: More strategic and Huang-Lao than pure Confucian ethics, less legalist-hard than 韩非子. Compared with 淮南’s broad cosmology, 鹖冠子 is tighter on state-war decision loops; 解 makes that operational lexicon legible.

entries.logic_thesis: Tang 冥报 narratives prove that moral causation is temporally extended beyond death and social visibility: unseen tribunals complete the ledger of deeds. The argument is eschatological accountability as the guarantor of ethical rationality.
entries.logic_chain: 1) If wrongdoing often prospers in life, ethics need a completion mechanism. 2) Hell-report stories supply that mechanism with narrative evidence. 3) Fear and hope become cognitive tools for behavioral reform. 4) Therefore retribution tales are moral technology, not mere scare folklore. 5) Conclusion: cosmic justice is claimed as structured, timed, and witnessable through signs.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi, read sudden collapses after ethical breaches as 官杀/劫财 enforcement timing, not random bad luck. 2) Use delayed retribution logic to explain multi-cycle payoffs. 3) For cultivation, install confession and repair practices before ‘court’ timing matures. 4) Treat nightmares and omens as early notices in a 冥报 system. 5) Counsel clients on 积德 as actual risk management in chart terms.
entries.logic_compare: More systematically Buddhist-retributive than general 志怪. Unlike 夷坚-style mixed marvels, 冥报记 has a prosecutorial structure (deed → underworld process → report), so its logic is judicial rather than purely wondrous.

entries.logic_thesis: Continuation of 玄怪 proves that the boundary between human time and otherworld time is porous, and that destiny appointments (marriage, office, death) are often pre-scripted yet interactively revealed. The argument is that narrative strangeness discloses a bookkeeping of fate behind ordinary careers.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ordinary biography seems contingent. 2) Otherworld encounters reveal prewritten registers. 3) If registers can be glimpsed or bargained with, fate is structured but not always opaque. 4) Continuation of the genre multiplies test cases of that structure. 5) Conclusion: life planning should include the logic of predestination-with-interfaces.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat BaZi as the ‘register’ layer; luck cycles as moments when register becomes readable through events. 2) For marriage/office pillars, expect meeting-point events that feel ‘arranged.’ 3) Practice dream and omen literacy as interface skills, not superstition. 4) Cultivate acceptance plus skilled response: change what 用神 allows, release what 忌神 locks. 5) When clients report uncanny timing, map it precisely to pillar activations.
entries.logic_compare: More literarily polished and fate-bureaucratic than early bare 齐谐 marvels. Compared with 冥报记, it is less hell-court moralism and more destiny-administration aesthetics—fate as office system rather than pure karmic prison.

entries.logic_thesis: As a sequel in the 齐谐 lineage, it proves that categorizing the strange preserves a cognitive method: anomaly types (dream, object spirit, seasonal portent) train pattern recognition of non-ordinary causality. The argument is taxonomized wonder as knowledge.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Unsorted marvels overwhelm judgment. 2) Genre continuation implies a stable typology. 3) Typology enables comparison and inference across cases. 4) Inference yields rules of encounter and taboo. 5) Conclusion: the strange becomes teachable through classification.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build a BaZi anomaly taxonomy: timing glitches, repeated number motifs, relationship echoes. 2) Match omen type to chart layer (daymaster mood vs year-pillar social field). 3) Teach clients simple taboo calendars tied to their 忌神 days. 4) Cultivate by classifying inner states as carefully as outer marvels. 5) Use short case cards rather than long lore for decision speed.
entries.logic_compare: Later and often more refined than 齐谐记 proper; less grand-geographical than 十洲记. Its difference from 续玄怪录 is scale and tone: more brief marvel entries and less elaborate fate-romance architecture.

entries.logic_thesis: Du Guangting’s immortal hagiography proves that transcendence is a path with techniques, virtues, and historical witnesses—not a vague metaphor. The argument is that immortality narratives encode a curriculum: discipline, timing, place, and teacher transmission.
entries.logic_chain: 1) If many biographies share stages (trial, formula, ascent), a method is implied. 2) Shared method implies learnable structure. 3) Hagiography thus functions as case law of cultivation success. 4) Daoist editorial selection emphasizes orthodox transmission. 5) Conclusion: spiritual attainment is argued by patterned life-evidence across persons.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Map immortal career stages onto BaZi luck cycles: training in weak resource years, breakthrough in supportive 印/食 cycles. 2) Extract concrete disciplines (fasting patterns, ethics, mountain retreat) as 用神 lifestyle. 3) Treat ‘teacher appearance’ motifs as 印星 activation timing. 4) Cultivate with biography-based milestones rather than vague aspiration. 5) Use failure stories in the corpus as risk models for 伤官见官-type spiritual arrogance.
entries.logic_compare: More systematically Daoist and soteriological than secular 志怪. Differs from 冥报记 by aiming at transcendence rather than underworld deterrence; differs from 十洲记 by focusing on persons and methods rather than sacred geography alone.

entries.logic_thesis: Xiao Ji’s treatise proves that Five-Phase theory is a complete inferential system: numbers, stems, branches, tones, organs, and politics can be deduced from phase relations if definitions and generative/control orders are held consistent. The argument is systematic correlative rationality.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Phases are defined by functional relations (生克). 2) Domains (time, body, ethics, state) are mapped onto those relations. 3) Mapping allows transfer of inference across domains. 4) Consistency checks prevent arbitrary symbolism. 5) Conclusion: Five-Phase is a logic engine for diagnosis and timing, not a pile of images.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Ground every BaZi judgment in explicit 生克制化 before story-telling. 2) Use classical correspondences (seasons, organs, directions) as constrained dictionaries. 3) When two techniques conflict, return to phase algebra as court of appeal. 4) Cultivate through seasonal regimen matching personal phase imbalances. 5) Drill transformation chains (e.g., 泄-耗-克) as decision trees for remedies.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike narrative 志怪 proofs, 五行大义 is axiomatic and encyclopedic. It differs from 淮南’s literary cosmology by being more scholastic and table-driven; it is the technical spine that later BaZi arithmetic assumes.

entries.logic_thesis: The Louguan temple corpus proves that sacred place, lineage memory, and imperial/religious endorsement co-produce Daoist authority. The argument is institutional: the Way is transmitted not only by texts and techniques but by a consecrated geography and commemorative record.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Cultivation claims need social and spatial anchors. 2) Temple history and numinous signs (紫云) certify those anchors. 3) Anthologizing miracles and genealogies stabilizes orthodoxy. 4) Orthodoxy enables standardized teaching. 5) Conclusion: spiritual legitimacy is argued through place-lineage-sign triangulation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In practice, treat ‘place luck’ (residence, altar direction) as coequal with natal chart for cultivation. 2) Seek teacher/lineage clarity as 印; avoid floating techniques without transmission. 3) Use commemorative ritual to lock intention (誓) into time. 4) Read temple-sign stories as models for verifying 感应 in sacred space. 5) Align retreats with personal 驿马/空亡 patterns for mountain practice timing.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike purely textual philosophers (管子/韩非子), this is sacred institutional memory. It differs from free immortal tales by centering one holy site’s continuity; its logic is foundation-and-lineage certification rather than portable story entertainment.

entries.logic_thesis: Early 齐谐-style recording proves that ‘strange’ is a legitimate object of knowledge: what exceeds common sense still obeys nameable motifs and moral-cosmic hints. The argument inaugurates anomaly as data for Heaven-Human inference.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Common sense covers only high-frequency events. 2) Low-frequency events still occur and recur in types. 3) Recording types builds a second-order map of reality. 4) That map feeds ritual caution and interpretive skill. 5) Conclusion: ignoring the strange is an incomplete epistemology.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Maintain a personal ‘齐谐’ log of rare chart events to expand model coverage. 2) Do not force every anomaly into textbook 十神; first describe, then classify. 3) Use early-zhiguai cautionary motifs as client risk metaphors. 4) Cultivate 戒—boundaries that protect against chaotic 感. 5) Train beginners on clear anomaly cases before subtle ones.
entries.logic_compare: More foundational and fragmentary than later sequels (续齐谐记) and grand Tang tales. Compared with 五行大义, it proves by narrative instance rather than by systematic phase algebra; it is the empirical folklore root of correlative fear and wonder.

entries.logic_thesis: The Ten Continents text proves that sacred geography is a cosmology in spatial form: immortality, herbs, and hierarchical isles encode graded access to Dao. The argument is that spiritual rank corresponds to locational ontology—where you can go depends on what you have become.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Space is morally and energetically stratified. 2) Each continent/isle holds specific substances and beings. 3) Access conditions imply cultivation prerequisites. 4) Geography thus teaches a ladder of transformation. 5) Conclusion: map-reading is rank-reading in Daoist imagination.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Translate ‘isles’ into practice zones: altar, retreat, travel, sleep—each with purity rules. 2) In BaZi, link 驿马 and resource stars to beneficial directions and moves. 3) Treat rare medicines/methods as phase-specific 用神, not universal panaceas. 4) Cultivate graded access: ethics before advanced techniques (no skip-island). 5) Use visualization of pure lands as 神 training without confusing map with tourism.
entries.logic_compare: More spatial-ontological than person-focused 仙传; more mythic atlas than 冥报 courtroom. Differs from 齐谐 short marvels by offering a structured otherworld cartography that functions as a curriculum of places.

entries.logic_thesis: The tale proves a political-destiny logic: true kingship and heroic talent are timed appointments under Heaven; recognizing 真命 and yielding at the right moment is supreme strategy. The argument is that force without cosmic timing fails, while insight into destiny reorders alliances and wealth.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Chaotic times multiply contenders. 2) Signs and talent-reading reveal the true sovereign trajectory. 3) The superior hero reallocates resources once destiny is clear. 4) Withdrawal to another field (海外) converts loss into alternative sovereignty. 5) Conclusion: wisdom is accurate destiny diagnosis plus non-resentful strategic redeployment.
entries.logic_practice: 1) In BaZi career reading, distinguish ‘can contend’ from ‘should contend’ using 帝旺 vs opposing 官杀 seasons. 2) Teach clients the 虬髯 move: when 用神 shows another’s rise, pivot domain rather than mutual destruction. 3) Read network triangulation (hero-heroine-guest) as 比劫/官/财 interaction model. 4) Cultivate 知止: stopping as advanced skill, not weakness. 5) Time major moves to luck pillars that support 迁移 and 食伤 output, not pure 七杀 brute push.
entries.logic_compare: Unlike pure immortal hagiography, it is chuanqi political theology in human drama. Differs from 韩非 institutional logic by centering charismatic destiny recognition; differs from 冥报 moral courts by resolving through strategic renunciation and alternate kingship rather than postmortem punishment.
